Welds seams and patches small holes left by booleans/threads — keeps colour, unlike a slicer's own repair.
File name
.ext
Exports all visible solids with the name above. For painting apps like Procreate, leave "Keep original UVs" off — OBJ is exported with a clean, non-overlapping unwrap so you won't get the "Unsupported Model Features" warning.
Session
Your work is auto-saved to this device as you go, so if the app closes or crashes before you export, it can be recovered next time you open it.
No auto-saved session yet.
"Delete" wipes the auto-saved copy and clears everything on screen — start fresh. This can't be undone.
Object
Duplicate · Settle onto plate · Delete. Shortcuts: Ctrl+C/X/V copy·cut·paste · Ctrl+Z undo · Del delete · Shift+click adds to selection
Mirror
Flip the selected object across an axis through its centre. Turn on "Keep original" to leave the original in place and add a mirrored copy (great for making left/right pairs).
Mirror across
X flips left↔right, Y flips up↔down, Z flips front↔back.
Measure
Click two points on any surface to measure the straight-line distance between them. This just draws a ghosted guide line — it never creates an object.
Distance —
Esc clears an in-progress measurement.
Screw Thread
Builds a helical screw thread as a solid you can drop into your model. Set the outer diameter, the pitch (distance between turns), and the length.
Type
A threaded rod — like a bolt or screw. Use it as-is, or combine it with your part.
Diameter 10 mm
Pitch (turn spacing) 1.5 mm
Length 20 mm
Handedness
Tip: for a threaded hole, make an Internal thread and use Booleans → Cut to subtract it from your part. Standard metric pitches: M6≈1.0, M8≈1.25, M10≈1.5. If a cut comes out torn or jagged, the boolean tool is struggling with the thread's complexity — try a shorter length or coarser pitch.
Revolve
Spins a baked sketch profile around an axis to make a round solid — heel cups, sockets, posts. Bake a closed sketch, select it, choose the axis, then Revolve.
Spin axis
Axis position 0 mm
0 spins around the profile's own edge. Move it to place the axis to one side (like a lathe centre) — the profile sweeps around that line.
Sweep angle 360°
Smoothness 64
Loft
Skins a smooth transition between two profiles — tapers, struts, funnels. Use two baked sketches, two solid faces (pick them with the Push/Pull tool), or one of each.
To loft between faces: switch to Push/Pull, click the two faces to pick them, then press Loft. Works best with similar, convex profiles.

Objects selected 0
Group is reversible (Ungroup). Merge fuses overlapping solids into a single mesh.
Snapping
Face snap sets a solid's faces flush against nearby solids. Center/inline snap lines up a solid's middle with another's — its centre, or its faces along an axis — so parts sit concentric or in a row. Use either, both, or neither.
Shell / Hollow
Turns the selected solid into a hollow shell with a set wall thickness — ideal for turning a scanned solid into a wearable device.
Wall thickness 2 mm
Detailed meshes take a few seconds. If it fails, try a smaller thickness or smooth/lower the resolution first.
Chamfer Edges
Flat bevel on picked edges (like Fillet, but a straight cut instead of a round). Pick edges with the Fillet tool, then chamfer.
Bevel size 2 mm
Array / Pattern
Repeat the selected solid or baked sketch — in a line, or evenly around a circle (holes, straps, posts, perforations).
Type
Count 4
Spacing X 25 mm
Spacing Y 0 mm
Spacing Z 0 mm
Circular copies are spaced evenly around a centre point. By default that's the middle of your object — or pick a point (like a tip) to rotate around instead.

No effects on this layer.
Non-destructive — the layer's pixels are never changed, so you can retune or switch effects off at any time.
A mask hides parts of a layer without deleting them. Turn on Edit mask, then paint: black hides, white reveals, grey is partial. Apply bakes it in; Delete discards it.
Select a shape with the Edit-points tool first. Vector layers (VEC) keep their shapes editable. Rasterize bakes a vector layer into pixels; Remove overlaps merges its filled shapes into one silhouette.
Brush

Tip
Import a PNG (ideally white/black on transparent) to use its shape as a brush tip — the way custom stamps work in Procreate or Photoshop. It picks up your current colour. Imported tips are saved on this device.
Tip angle 45°
Shape
Fill, stroke and angle-snap for this shape are in the bar under the canvas. Draw on a vector (VEC) layer to keep shapes editable afterwards with the Edit-points tool.
Corners / points 5

Text
Font, size and colour are in the bar under the canvas. Click existing text with the Text tool to retype it. Use "Flatten text" on the Layers tab to bake it permanently.
Selection
While a selection is active, painting only affects the inside of it. Ctrl+A selects all, Ctrl+D or Esc deselects. With Move-selected you can drag the lifted pixels as many times as you like — they only settle when you deselect or change tool.
Transform
Make a selection first (or it uses the whole layer). Drag corners to scale, drag outside the box to rotate, drag inside to move. Hold the corner and it keeps aspect. Commit with the button or Enter; Esc cancels.
This tool has no extra settings — everything it needs is in the bar under the canvas.
